footnotes.footnote: This transaction is part of a related series of transactions. The Reporting Person acquired rights to 675,000 shares of Class B Common Stock upon incremental vesting of previously granted restricted stock units ("RSUs") on November 20, 2025, converted 308,635 shares of the Class B Common Stock to Class A Common Stock and immediately sold the resulting shares of Class A Common Stock on November 20, 2025 and then converted 39,136 shares of the Class B Common Stock to Class A Common Stock and immediately sold the resulting shares of Class A Common Stock on November 21, 2025. All sales were automatic sales of shares to cover required tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting event on November 20, 2025.
The Class B Common Stock is convertible into the Issuer's Class A Common Stock on a 1-for-1 basis and has no expiration date.
